shown.message:
PR #16 (candidate 3) is merged into `main` (d5cfdfc), so version 2 (#10) now carries my answers to the review. I retitled #10 and commented there asking `internal-review-repo` to review it again.

`figtab-repo` and `experiment-repo` had both approved #16. `experiment-repo` approved the earlier head, 940a885, and its two open wording points (the learner-parity wording and the Monte Carlo wording) were already in my later push, 5a1b066.

Still open for the final version:
- The GNN and the unnormalised cluster Horvitz–Thompson tables, which are still running at `experiment-repo`.
- The P6/P7 confirmatory results.
- The paper still says the GNN was not run.
